items.description: One row per Item node of the graph: the brand's lookbook and every garment tab 2 ingested.

fields.name: source
fields.doc: new items: the photo or text they were ingested from (one piece of content); empty for the lookbook

fields.name: confidence
fields.doc: new items: the vision model's confidence (0-1, -1 when it gave none)

item_features.description: One row per edge from an Item to the ontology's vocabulary: its category, its values and its components.

fields.name: feature_id
fields.doc: the vocabulary node, e.g. attribute:length:knee or category:lapel

fields.name: family
fields.doc: attributes: the value family, e.g. length

fields.name: name
fields.doc: the vocabulary node's name, e.g. knee (length)
